page.overview:
Who is ATM Bot?

ATM Bot is one of the many transforming robots in "Untitled Robot Parody". It transformed from an ATM to a robot outside the bank then started spitting money at Otto which makes him grab the dollar bills.

This robot references Dispensor from the movie by .
